description: Submit the user's answer (text) to the current question in the mock interview in progress, same as editing and clicking "Send" on the page; the AI interviewer then asks the next question or ends the interview. Not possible while the interviewer is still asking. Requires the user to have this session open in the browser or desktop app and connected; the page carries it out exactly as if the user clicked the matching button. (Requires the user's sign-in with scope interviews:write.)
name: answer_mock_interview
